subject: Re: Invoice discrepancy — request to reconcile overcharge from Oct 31 incident
messages:
From: Sara Lambert <sara.lambert@raincrest.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@raincrest.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unexpected charge on Nov invoice — possible duplicate token counting

Hi Connor,

Hope you’re well. We received our November invoice this morning (INV-2026-11-01.pdf attached) and it looks like our token usage for Oct 31 has been counted roughly double what Raincrest expected based on our internal logs. Line items are showing ~2.1M tokens for Oct 31 when our internal aggregator shows ~980k tokens for the same period.

Can you confirm whether you experienced any serving incident or billing miscount on Oct 31 that might explain the discrepancy? We’re trying to reconcile ahead of our month-end close and may need to hold payment if this is an overcharge.

Sample items that would help: a) any incident ID or incident timeframe, b) a short excerpt of token audit rows for Oct 31 UTC 03:00–04:00, and c) whether you intend to apply a credit or adjustment.

Thanks — appreciate a quick read.

Sara Lambert
Head of Finance Operations
Raincrest AI
Phone: +1 415 555 0198

Attachment: INV-2026-11-01.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lambert <sara.lambert@raincrest.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected charge on Nov invoice — possible duplicate token counting

Hi Sara — thanks for flagging this and sharing the invoice.

Short version: we saw a transient cache-replay issue on 2026-10-31 that resulted in a small subset of requests being re-sent to the serving layer, which inflated token accounting for some customers for a ~20-minute window. I’m escalating to finance now (cc Evelyn) to assemble an audit extract and a provisional credit.

Can you confirm one or two sample request IDs or timestamps from your logs (if available) so we can pull the exact rows? If you don’t have IDs handy, your mention of the spike at Oct 31 is enough — we’ll pull all traffic for Raincrest during 2026-10-31T03:15:00Z–03:40:00Z and send an extract.

We’ll aim to send an initial reconciliation and proposed credit within 48 business hours. Apologies for the noise — I know month-end timing is painful.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0222
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Invoice reconciliation — Raincrest AI (internal)

Connor/Sean — I pulled the token audit for Raincrest during the window Connor flagged. Attached: token_audit_oct31.csv (excerpted for the 03:15–03:40 UTC window). Findings:

- Raw token count rows show duplicated replay for ~20% of requests due to a cache reissue event between 2026-10-31T03:22:15Z and 2026-10-31T03:41:02Z.
- Net overcount for the day: 1,120,412 tokens.
- Using Raincrest’s plan rate ($0.011/token equivalent for this calculation), the gross overcharge = $12,324.53. We should propose a credit in that ballpark and apply it to INV-2026-11-01.

Proposed next steps:
1) Connor to confirm the calculation and send the extract to Raincrest (redact internal ids).
2) Issue a provisional credit on the invoice and send an updated PDF.
3) Once Raincrest confirms the rows, finalize credit and close.

I’ll mark as provisional until Sara confirms matching rows.

Evelyn Hart
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: token_audit_oct31.csv
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lambert <sara.lambert@raincrest.ai>, Raincrest AI Billing <billing@raincrest.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice discrepancy — request to reconcile overcharge from Oct 31 incident

Hi Sara / Raincrest billing team — attaching a short excerpt from our audit for the Oct 31 cache-replay window (token_audit_excerpt.txt). Per Evelyn’s calculation, we identified an overcount of 1,120,412 tokens attributable to the replay incident. We’ve prepared a provisional credit of $12,324.53 which we will apply to invoice INV-2026-11-01.

What we’ve done so far:
- Applied provisional credit of $12,324.53 to INV-2026-11-01 (you’ll see a credit line on your portal and an updated PDF within 24 hours).
- Opened HubSpot ticket HS-98213 to track this reconciliation (link below).
- Attached an excerpt of the token audit for the window; full CSV already provided to Raincrest via the secure Drive link.

Please review the attached excerpt and confirm the rows line up with your internal events. If you agree, we’ll finalize the credit and update your account ledger. If you’d prefer a direct refund instead of a credit, we can process that once we have confirmation (refunds take ~3–5 business days).

Thanks again for the quick heads-up — we’ll keep this prioritized.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: token_audit_excerpt.txt
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/HS-98213
From: Sara Lambert <sara.lambert@raincrest.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Raincrest AI Billing <billing@raincrest.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice discrepancy — request to reconcile overcharge from Oct 31 incident

Connor / Evelyn — thanks for the quick turnaround and the excerpt. I reviewed the excerpt against our request logs and can confirm the rows match our internal replayed requests. The provisional credit of $12,324.53 is acceptable — please apply it as described and send the updated invoice/portal notice.

We prefer the credit applied to the invoice rather than a separate refund at this time. Once the credit is visible on our portal and the updated PDF is posted, we’ll mark the ticket as resolved on our side. Appreciate the responsiveness, and please loop me in if you need anything else for audit trails.

Best,
Sara Lambert
Head of Finance Operations
Raincrest AI
Attachment: none
